# A Million Followers Is a Rented Institution — motion and channel evidence manifest

Version 2.0 · RN Collins · 7 September 2026

## Reels / TikTok / Shorts
### 0–8s — OBJ-106420
Voiceover: Construction evidence can outlive the operating house—but only if the physical object and record stay paired.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Gift of Miss Eva Drexel Dahlgren, 1976

Rights: Public Domain / Met Open Access

### 8–16s — CO06-DIAGRAM-1
Voiceover: 01 · REACH — What can the platform do exceptionally well?. Discovery, social proof, conversation, cultural participation, and rapid distribution are real institutional advantages. The audit begins by naming that value rather than treating dependency as failure.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 16–24s — CO06-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · ACCESS — Who can enter and recover the account?. Record the account owner, administrators, authentication method, recovery contacts, device access, and escalation route. A display name or founder face does not prove operational control.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 24–32s — CO06-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · PORTABILITY — What can leave with consent and context?. Map content originals, captions, contacts, customer records, permissions, analytics exports, and conversation history. Preserve only what may lawfully and ethically be retained.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — CO06-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · ROUTE — How many ways can the institution reach people?. Build at least one controlled destination and one consent-based contact route. Redundancy should improve continuity without manipulating audiences or copying data beyond its stated purpose.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 40–48s — S08
Voiceover: Personal Digital Archiving is retained as evidence, education, reporting or rights context.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Library of Congress
